rd.researchQuestion: Can a zero-runtime HTML/CSS contract express a fixed character grid with coordinate placement, bounds, collision, overflow, and order rules that are reusable beyond IBM 3270?
rd.technicalUncertainty: Whether CSS Grid, registered custom properties, and subgrid can place runs by absolute cell coordinates without inline style or script, while staying contained at 320px and correct at 200% text size.
